einzeiler: Two Australian women charm London high society before launching a massive investment…
kurzfassung: Two Australian women arrive in 1990s London and captivate high society with their colorful personalities and wealth. They soon launch an exclusive investment scheme that cons wealthy businessmen and horse-racing elites out of fortunes. Decades later, the story behind the grand deception and the detective who pursued them is revealed.
stichpunkte: Two Australian women arrive in 1990s London and quickly become favorites of high society
The pair charm wealthy businessmen and England's horse-loving elite with their outrageous lifestyle
They begin promoting an exclusive investment opportunity that promises massive financial returns
The duo even manage to secure a meeting with Queen Elizabeth
Underneath the glamour, the millionaire duo conceal a dark past and malicious intentions
A small town detective vows to stop the pair after uncovering their exploits
Decades later, one of the perpetrators speaks out about the crimes
Royal Swindle premieres on Thursday, July twenty third from usg Audio Blanchard House and exactly right media

clips.hook: Two ossie lesbian lovers in nineties London
clips.text: Two Australian women captivated London's elite in the 1990s with their flamboyant lifestyle and unconventional habit of carrying large amounts of cash.
The pair successfully manipulated wealthy entrepreneurs and members of the equestrian community into handing over significant sums of money.

clips.hook: The ramifications of this were huge
clips.text: Victims faced a harrowing choice between financial ruin and public humiliation, leading some to describe the women as genuinely malevolent figures.
Despite their reputation for criminal activity, the duo evaded law enforcement for years until one participant eventually decided to confess.

clips.hook: I would say I'm very sorry, but whether I've mean or not
clips.text: One of the primary figures reflects on her past actions with a cynical lack of genuine remorse.

beschreibung:
Two Aussie lesbian lovers touch down in 1990s London and become the toast of British high society. They charm rich businessmen, England's horse-loving elite, and even Queen Elizabeth herself. But the glamorous duo are concealing a dark past and dastardly intentions—and when a small-town detective vows to bring them down, he finds they are exceedingly hard to catch.
Hosted by award-winning journalist Becky Milligan. Royal Swindle is a Blanchard House production for USG Audio, in partnership with Exactly Right Media.
Premieres Thursday, July 23rd. Follow Royal Swindle wherever you get your podcasts—and see rare photos from the story at @exactlyright on Instagram.
